notes.title: New Carrotoa Area
notes.content: [h1]Carrotoa[/h1][p]We've added a new area to the game 'Carrotoa'.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/4e0cd78c51c3c237b9b506ebc5d2cfc870568721.png"][/img][/p][p]This island is a result of a volcanic eruption long ago. You start in a central caldera and move to the outside cliffs where trees and grass have started to flourish. This level is more difficult than most of the others, in contrast of our last level Rimeglade.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/a01a5e9d3d6a80222466519679f3c124687ee59a.png"][/img][/p][p]Season tokens and Beach Ball mode are also included for this large level. You can enter the new area from the HUB world near the tropical islands and desert; Carrotoa is unlocked for all players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/967a2406d9103c2c0a3c7c3c016f2d5c4de15170.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Rimeglade Area
notes.content:
[h1]Rimeglade[/h1]
We've added a new area to the game 'Rimeglade'. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/3f9c07c2eef5ee8d3cfe8c13cf2851b2f83c1d00.png[/img]

This is a lightly forested area with a serene lake at its center. Enjoy the calming atmosphere being nestled within the surrounding mountains. This level is less difficult than most of the others for a more chill experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/d8d01a3db00442c79882b4490522fe1692beb145.png[/img]

We've also added support for the 'A Horse for all Seasons' tokens and even the 'Beach Ball Summer' mode. You can enter the new area from the HUB world near small river; Rimeglade is unlocked for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/a72f6ac1b14dddcf457eaa563f7e6479d6c62e66.png[/img]

notes.title: A Horse for All Seasons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/c83728de028c0c5c1faa3e5abfcc0e5f86409458.png[/img]

[h1]A Horse for All Seasons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Collect tokens for each season to unlock that season's horse
[*] Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter tokens can be found in worlds that represent that season (examples, Winterlands has 5 Winter tokens, Lazy River has 1 Spring, 1 Summer and 3 Autumn tokens)
[*] Tokens spawn every time you enter a level, so you can replay the levels you want to collect them
[*] After getting all 4 season horses a new world unlocks, Tidelands. This world has a rising and lowering tide
[*] Complete all levels in the Tidelands world to unlock the Moon horse Lunama
[*] Collect Stardust across worlds as Lunama to unlock the Sun horse Soleda
[*] You can check your progress from the "Horse for all Seasons" option in the game's main menu
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/6b4362765857aba90050d1e906121f6ce8d73bbb.png[/img]
[i]Autumn Horse[/i]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] We wanted to make it more easy to navigate the worlds so we've added a Minimap to the top right corner of the screen. 
[*] Replaced the compass with the Minimap. The arrow in the minimap points in the direction you are facing
[*] We've seen people didn't like the rough terrain found in levels, so we've done a pass over each of the worlds and smoothed out a lot of the terrain. The horse should get stopped on terrain that looks smooth much less frequently. We'll continue to smooth out terrain as we find problems
[*] Fixed a bug where switching save files would fail to reset some values
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/91fdfe303139d7ed59a75c0cb770a497f6856b9b.png[/img]
[i]Map of the Hub[/i]

notes.title: Beach Ball Summer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/b81758e4e058214481c9d6ad59bf44a35d301f65.png[/img]

[h1]Beach Ball Summer![/h1]
[list]
[*] New Game Mode: Beach Ball Summer
[*] Find the giant beach balls and knock them into the the large glowing goal zones
[*] Get 5 beach balls into the goal zones to complete each level
[*] Each world gets its own level and unique beach ball unlock
[*] Complete each world to unlock all the beach balls
[*] Select beach ball mode from the main menu to try it out
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/02f354538aae3ed594fa67cbc6d33be663b8141a.png[/img]

notes.title: Wintertime!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/4884164e9500afa63bb3d6c01fc478b7e4fd7b5e.png[/img]

[h1]Wintertime![/h1]
[list]
[*] Brave the cold to explore the new Wintertime world. Snowy plains and hills hide the things you hope to find 
[*] There are 4 levels in this world spanning in difficulty from easy to hard
[*] Three new 'animals' can be found here: Snowmen, Decorated Trees and Gifts
[*] Unlock the new Reindeer skin by finding spirits. Collect 5 spirits from the original worlds to prance around with a red nose
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/a4e058d762aa9f12f51ce7e154fe2719cecc70cf.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/130fbea6ab7ca3a4f6dc1de4b0dceb665fe69e41.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween![/h1]
[list]
[*] Trot carefully as you explore the new Halloween world. This dark foggy place is lit with orange lanterns to help you find your way
[*] There are 4 levels in this world spanning in difficulty from easy to hard
[*] A new 'animal' "Pumpkin" can be found here in the 1st and 4th levels
[*] Unlock the new Ghost Horse skin by conversing with the spirits. Collect 3 spirits from the original worlds to haunt the game with your transparent horse
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42219717/077476c33b76386ec386b17006f84e5e058f67fb.png[/img]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added text to world portal screens saying that you should pick a level to play; this wasn't clear previously
[*] Added a large particle effect above each world portal so you can see where the entrances of each world are from far away
[/list]

notes.title: Accessibility Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a toggle 'Cursor Lock' to the Settings menu. You can toggle this off to play the game with the cursor visible and able to move around freely. This is to support software that maps mouse movements to keys
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody playing the game!

Here are a couple of day 1 changes:
[list]
[*] Added a sign for 'Hub Isle' to convey that the island you start on is a hub to reach other locations
[*] Made the beams of light for animals very tall for the first two levels (beagle and pig). This is to make the start of the game easier
[/list]
